name: omp-advisor-consensus
description: Self-contained adversarial goal loop: an independent reviewer turn re-prompts the agent until the goal is actually met

omp.description: Run an independent reviewer after every turn and re-prompt the main session until the goal is met. No advisor dependency, no escalation: the loop stops only on an accepted goal or an explicit pause/off.

enabled.description: Arm the convergence loop. Off by default; arm per session with /adversarial on or durably with `omp plugin config --set enabled=true`.

minSeverity.description: Lowest reviewer finding severity that keeps the loop running.

maxRounds.description: Soft budget of continuation turns per user prompt. Crossing it raises pressure and notifies; it never hands the goal back.

maxRepeats.description: Times the reviewer may re-raise the same finding before the next round runs under stall pressure.

notify.description: Toast each round, convergence, stall pressure, and budget crossing.
